comparison.objective: Unmold a tart by supporting its base and lowering a loose pan ring; candidate registers industrial switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fragile-food support and ring separation versus controlled fastener release, mounted-part sliding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Tart must remain intact on its base/stand while the ring clears without drop or damage; candidate requires two sensed endpoints retained after tightening.
comparison.reason: Only generic bimanual coordination is shared. The record does not test calibration, sensing clearance, or fastening.
